name: Shiratori Kana
source: A sweet and gentle ojou-sama who has fallen deeply in love with Tetsuya and wants to date him but can't because of her father. [spoiler]Forced to keep her virginity till marriage and unable to go against the wishes of her father she begs Tetsuya to rape her so she can have everything she wants.[/spoiler]
